exposure: Piperonyl Butoxide (PBO) administered orally at 200, 500, and 1000 mg/kg/day
cohort: Timed-pregnant CD(r) (Sprague Dawley) rats were randomly assigned to a control and three treatment groups of 25 females each.
finding: PBO caused dose-dependent maternal toxicity (clinical observations, body weight/food reductions, increased liver weights) at 500 and 1000 mg/kg/day, but no treatment-related effects on fetal development, including resorptions, live fetuses, sex ratio, fetal weight, or malformations/variations, were observed at any tested dose level.
gest_age: The fetuses were evaluated at gestation day 21.
